name: heliopause
description: A host firewall you can't lock yourself out of — declarative nftables with commit/confirm/auto-rollback
author: mack-erel
//workspaces: packages/enroll-app is deliberately NOT here, and that is a decision rather than an oversight.
It is a Tauri desktop app: its npm side is the Tauri CLI, a platform binary that every job
running `npm ci` would then download, and its real dependency tree is Cargo's. Hoisting it
would put a large build-only binary in the root lockfile for the benefit of nobody who runs
What it costs is that `directory: /` in dependabot does not reach it, so it has its own npm
and cargo entries there; and that nothing in `npm test` touches it, so what it does is pinned
statically by `src/enroll-app-cli-contract.test.ts` — both ends of the CLI contract, the
sanitiser, and the Tauri permission set. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` has an `enrolment app` job
for the two things a static read cannot see.
